name: Glass Identification Benchmark Dataset
description: The Glass Identification dataset contains 214 forensic samples of glass described by refractive index and weight percentages of 8 element oxides (Na, Mg, Al, Si, K, Ca, Ba, Fe). Sourced from the Home Office Forensic Science Service to benchmark multiclass classification across building and vehicle window glass.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 42 (DOI: 10.24432/C5WW2P) and German standard forensic reference.

size.notes: Comma-separated text table with 9 continuous physical/chemical features and 1 integer label.
